title: Traveller Club Benefits and the Service Element Retained on Car Hire
content:
Where money is returned on a Car Rental Rate Classes rental, the renter's Wanderlane Traveller Club
membership may change what the desk retains for its service. What decides it is the tier the renter's
membership stands at, the benefits that tier carries, and whether money stands settled in advance on the
rental.

**Where the renter holds an active club membership whose tier carries the waiver of the agency service fee
and money has been settled in advance on the rental**, nothing is retained.

**Where the renter holds an active club membership whose tier carries a car rental discount and money has
been settled in advance on the rental**, the rate class's agency service fee less that tier's car rental
discount is retained.

**Where neither holds**, no reduction under this head is made to what the desk retains.

## Marks of each case

The two rows are taken in the order they stand. A tier carrying both the waiver of the agency service fee
and a car rental discount is answered by the first row, and nothing is retained.

A membership that is not active reaches neither row, whatever tier it names.

Money settled in advance is a mark of both rows. A rental on which nothing has been settled in advance
reaches neither, whatever the renter's tier.

## A retained figure worked through

A rental on a class whose agency service fee is 12.95 USD, carrying advance payments, held by a renter whose
active membership stands at a tier carrying a car rental discount of 10 per cent: the service element
retained is 12.95 USD less 10 per cent of it, which is 11.655 USD. Held by a renter whose active membership
stands at a tier carrying the waiver of the agency service fee: nothing is retained.
